title: Odd job interviews
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What is the strangest interview question you have ever heard or been asked?
Do unusual interview questions reveal anything useful about a candidate?
Should employers be allowed to test applicants with stressful or surprising situations?
How would you respond if an interviewer asked a question that felt irrelevant or inappropriate?
What would you ask candidates if you wanted to understand how they think rather than what they have memorised?
